headline: Executive order creates a presidential medal to honor public safety officers for acts of bravery.
what_it_does: This order sets up the Presidential Medal of Valor for Public Safety Officers, a national award from the President. Based on the title, it is meant to honor public safety officers for acts of bravery. No summary was provided, so details such as who picks the winners and how are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Public safety officers, such as police officers and firefighters
who_it_affects.how: They could be considered for a new presidential award recognizing bravery.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely when signed on June 29, 2000, though no summary confirms this.
